FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Which package is right for me?

It depends on your budget and how much direct feedback you want. If you’re happy following a plan independently, Basic is enough. Advanced is our most popular package because it includes weekly access to Matteo plus Vekta membership.

I'm based in the USA — does coaching work remotely?

All coaching is delivered online — plans, feedback, testing and communication happen asynchronously via Vekta or Training Peaks, with calls scheduled to suit your time zone, whether you’re on the East Coast, West Coast, or anywhere between.

Do you only coach people who race?

No. We coach riders working toward weight loss, their first century ride, general fitness, Gran Fondos, triathlon or racing — the only requirement is that you ride a bike and want to improve.

Do I need to switch from Training Peaks to Vekta?

No — we can continue working in Training Peaks if you’re already comfortable there, or explore Vekta’s Critical Power and W′ analytics alongside it.

What age do I need to be?

We coach all ages, 14 and up — no upper limit. Riders under U23 receive a 20% student discount.

My event is months away — can I still sign up now?

Yes. Based on how far away is the event you can choose any suitable package.

CYCLING COACH USA

Train with Italian Head Coach Matteo Cigala — from anywhere in the USA.

BOOK FREE CONSULTATION

Matteo brings over 28 years of cycling experience, more than a decade of coaching riders around the world, and hundreds of race victories. He provides personalised coaching for road cycling, gravel, MTB, gran fondos and endurance riders, with every training plan built around your goals, your schedule and your lifestyle.

Whether you’re in California, Colorado, New York, Texas, Florida or anywhere else in the USA, training for a gran fondo, preparing for a gravel race, competing in local or USA Cycling events, or working towards your next big cycling goal, your coaching is fully tailored to help you perform at your best.

  • Powered by Vekta, a next-generation training platform used by WorldTour teams (membership worth €19.99/month included free)
  • Training Peaks also available if you’re already set up there
  • Adaptive training zones that update as your fitness changes
  • Full support for sportives, Gran Fondos, time trials, road racing and general performance goals
  • Syncs with Garmin, Wahoo, Zwift and more
  • Nutritional guidance and access to a sports nutritionist and mental coach
  • Daily session carb reccomendations
  • Communication designed around US time zones — daily/weekly contact regardless of your coast
